name: Gensuishou ~Crystal Fantasy~
source:
There is a legend that the couple that sees "Crystal Fantasy" in this amusement park will love each other forever. Four friends come to this park at night to try and reveal the mystery. Whatever happens next depends on the choices.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
传说，在这个游乐园里看到《水晶幻想》的情侣会永远相爱。四个朋友晚上来到这个公园，试图揭开这个谜团。接下来发生什么取决于选择。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
